long: Need for Speed: Carbon is a 2006 arcade racing game and sequel to Most Wanted. Players build a crew and race through the city of Palmont, including high-speed canyon duels against rival gang leaders. It features customizable cars, open-world street racing, and territory control gameplay.
name: Need for Speed: Carbon (2006)
